Subject: Quick recap & ask — next steps to identify who signs for budget

Hi Samir — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and two asks so we can move toward a pilot proposal:

1) What we heard:
- Use case: on-demand inference for pathology-image annotation pipeline (batch and low-latency API).
- Volume profile: 50–200 reqs/min peak, mostly short sequences but occasional long batches for nightly processing.
- Success criteria: latency under 300ms p95 for interactive tooling, cost target ~ $0.004/token equivalent for heavy batch runs.

2) Immediate asks: please confirm (a) who ultimately signs off on budget/contract (title + name/email), and (b) who manages security/compliance checks (SOC2/audit contact) and procurement routing. If helpful, a single line with office roles is perfect (e.g., Finance: Jane Doe <jane@..>, Security: Asha Rao <asha@..>).

Attachments: I included a brief mutual-action-plan (MAP) with proposed milestones and a security snapshot for your security/compliance team to review.

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call next week with procurement + security + your technical lead so we can pin timelines for a pilot and a commercial offer. What days work for you?

Thanks — I’ll loop in our pricing lead once we have the budget owner identified.

—
Mina Haddad
